[{"insert":"Split Stance DB RDL

This is the final RDL of the cycle, and reps climb to eight per side, the most single leg hinging you have done in the block. The split stance drives the load into the front hamstring and glute while the back leg only helps you balance. Push the front hip straight back, keep the dumbbells close and your back flat, and stand tall with a glute squeeze at the top. Hold a steady weight across all three sets and make every rep smooth and controlled.
"}]
